name: tiyouju-community
description: 题有据社区：Cloudflare Workers + D1 + R2 + Turnstile，独立部署，不进桌面安装包

scripts.dev: npm run build && wrangler dev --config worker/wrangler.toml
scripts.db:local: wrangler d1 execute tiyouju-community --local --config worker/wrangler.toml --file schema.sql
scripts.db:remote: wrangler d1 execute tiyouju-community --remote --config worker/wrangler.toml --file schema.sql
scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler deploy --config worker/wrangler.toml
